pinned_dataset.commit_title: Add LingBot_VLA ckpt and fix mug 00014 handle (#61)

official_evaluation_protocol.seed_to_layout_mapping: Outer seed (`--seed`, default 0; leaderboard [0, 1, 2]) selects directory `Assets/Eval_Layout/RoboDojo/<embodiment>/<seed>/`. `SeedManager.init_eval()` sorts matching `<task_name>_<n>.json` files numerically by `<n>` and assigns 0-based `layout_id = 0 .. N-1`. At SHA 1127bda94f172d757386945af3eb3a6754d1a4e6, `<n>` is contiguous `0 .. N-1` for every config and seed, so `layout_id == <n>`. Nominal scored layouts are `0 .. eval_num - 1`; spare layouts `eval_num .. N - 1` are drawn sequentially only when earlier episodes drop via UnStableError, PhysXBrokenError, mark_env_unstable, or unhandled exceptions.

evaluator.instruction_template: Use the set square to push the three blocks into a straight, aligned row, then reset the robot arm.
evaluator.e3_form_summary: Tool use is in the instruction but not measured; any pushing strategy passes.

evaluator.e3_form_summary: Measures the instruction; digits are unique within a texture group (config instance_sample_mode unique).

evaluator.instruction_template: Build a tower using the wooden blocks and wooden boards.

evaluator.instruction_template: Sort the objects by category into the three baskets.
evaluator.e3_form_summary: Correct mapping is forced because baskets are static and disjoint (config Geometry at x = -0.28, 0, 0.28); the receptacle test is a footprint.

evaluator.instruction_template: Put {cat0} objects into the left basket, {cat1} objects into the middle basket, and {cat2} objects into the right basket, then reset the robot arm.
evaluator.e3_form_summary: Matches the instruction; 'left' is smaller x, consistent with other tasks. Category names are raw model names (e.g. toy_car).

evaluator.instruction_template: Cover the blocks from left to right, remember their colors, then uncover them in the order: red, green, and blue.
evaluator.e3_form_summary: The memory component is not measured: wrong uncoverings are free, so a memoryless peek-and-recover policy can succeed within 32 s. The covered test also cannot tell 'over' from 'on' for 2.5 cm cubes, which would hide #25.

evaluator.instruction_template: Pick up the coin from the holder and insert it precisely into the coin bank.

evaluator.instruction_template: Insert and tighten each screw into the nut of the same color.
